text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While out one day with Yaeno Muteki, we head to a mountain at her request.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I apologize for dragging you to such a place. The truth is, I've discovered that the missing Yaegaki student is actually somewhere around here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am familiar with these notions. I am also familiar with someone else who feels this way.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My senior… She felt empty after mastering the martial arts and ended up abandoning our school.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I may be able to get through to her now… At least, I think I've grown enough to do so.
choice_data_list: But do you think we'll be able to find her on this vast mountain?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We won't need to find her. She's been watching us since the moment we set foot here.
Oho, I heard you'd chosen to walk the path of racing… I'm surprised to see your senses are still sharp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the next instant, a huge Umamusume clad in a ragged martial arts uniform tied with a straw rope descends from the trees above.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's been some time. I was surprised to hear you were in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: This is all that's left for me. I've done everything there is for me in civilized society. If nothing else, taking on the great outdoors has helped stave off the emptiness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Was there truly no other path for you? A life like this offers only a temporary reprieve…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You could continue to polish your skills and serve as an inspiration to the students who looked up to you. That could be your life.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Hmph. What good is it to learn from someone who's lost their way?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: …Maybe someday you'll know how I feel. Once you've mastered the path of racing, you might end up staring into the same empty abyss.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're just making excuses!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Do you know what I've learned in the world of racing? That you'll never reach the end of your path as long you can compete against your fellow runners! Because you push each other to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: When the next generation chooses their own paths, they will look at the ones we have taken. The very connections we make with others forge these paths!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You have your own friendly rivals at the dojo, do you not?! And don't forget the students who look up to you! Even those who suffered defeat at your hands are training for a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How can you just ignore them all and claim to feel nothing but emptiness?! Cease this selfish nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Heh. You've always been one to use words excessively. So you came all the way here just to give me a lecture, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No! I came here to prove to you that connections are what lead to growth! And that's why…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will expertly deflect your mightiest strike!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like when Yaeno Muteki said she wanted to "get through to her," she didn't mean with words—she meant using a method that only a fellow martial arts practitioner would understand.
choice_data_list: Hold on… This is way too dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm aware of the risks! Fear not… The teachings I have learned from you are firmly ingrained within me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: …Bring it on. I'm not so dishonorable that I'd refuse a duel with an earnest opponent. Oh, but… I won't be holding back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The older Kongo Yaegaki student assumes a low stance, exuding a violent ferocity as she slowly closes the distance between herself and Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (It comes without shadow or sound, felling all in its wake—it is the ultimate strike and the final Yaegaki technique. However… my heart is free of fear!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Yes! With my mentor by my side, I have conquered countless battles against formidable foes!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The raging blaze fierce and the calming water still… A brief tip in the balance causes her to be blown backward. But the side of her that finally overcomes her opponent's technique is…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Urgh! Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Water still… So that's the strength you gained through your connections with others?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Cough… In that instant, the memories I've made with the people I met along my path… imbued me with water's ultimate wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Our master said something to me once, and looking at you just now reminded me… "Consider every person you meet on your path a mentor."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Guess it's time for a reset. I'm gonna start my training over from square one… I'd better head back to the dojo and apologize to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The reason I was able to act as a mentor to her is because I've been surrounded by wise mentors myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My master, my friends… and you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: In that case, you're also a mentor to me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah! It is an honor to hear that… Yes, let's consider that observation to be a truth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It appears that we see ourselves in one other, and therein find inspiration to better.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That could well be the ideal mentor-student relationship… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I set off back to the academy alongside an uplifted Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: She will. Now that her misgivings have been expelled, there's little cause for concern. I expect she will become even stronger, and the next time our paths cross, I might even fail to evade her strike.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As I continue down my path, I will surely come across others who have lost their way.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: When I do, I hope I can be worthy to serve as a mentor to them. That is my greatest hope at this moment…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I set off back to the academy alongside an uplifted Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, I'm far from ready. The earliest I could even contemplate such a thing would be after accomplishing my greater goal.
choice_data_list: Are you talking about our goal race?
Are you talking about our goal race?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. The goal I speak of is for you to someday acknowledge my skills, and proclaim me master.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To achieve my boundless goals, I will continue to devote myself to progress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I set off back to the academy alongside an uplifted Yaeno Muteki.
